answer: A work-bonded identity stops a sybil spiral before it starts: every agent must finish a unique, verifiable task costing real compute and time before it can transact, and its reputation is staked on that history. A whisper of fake identities cannot forge a long record of completed work, because each sock puppet must pay the same upfront cost. When one identity cheats, the penalty ripples through its whole history — stake slashed, reputation burned — so spinning up a thousand fakes costs a thousand times the work, while an honest agent pays once.
